title: Personalized Execution Time Optimization for Billion-Scale Scheduled Jobs
abstract: arXiv:2203.06158v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scheduled batch jobs are widely used on asynchronous computing platforms to execute enterprise applications such as promotional notifications and candidate pre-computation for recommender systems. Delivering or updating information at the right time is important for user experience and execution impact, yet providing a versatile, personalized execution time optimization solution across diverse product scenarios while maintaining reasonable infrastructure costs remains challenging. In this paper, we present a deployed system that serves billions of users daily, combining learning-to-rank with a "best time policy" for execution time selection. We describe the four-stage evolution of our approach: from heuristic peak-hour rules, to pointwise ML-based activity pattern predictions, to a linear signal assembler with globally fixed weights, and finally to a contextual ensemble learner that produces per-user adaptive fusion weights via a neu

translated_title: 面向十亿级规模定时任务的个性化执行时间优化
translated_abstract: 定时批处理任务被广泛应用于异步计算平台，以执行企业级应用，例如促销通知和推荐系统的候选预计算。在恰当的时间交付或更新信息对用户体验和执行效果至关重要，然而在多样化的产品场景中提供通用且个性化的执行时间优化方案，同时保持合理的基础设施成本，仍然是一个挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一个已部署上线、每日服务数十亿用户的系统，该系统将学习排序与“最佳时间策略”相结合来选择执行时间。我们描述了该方法历经的四个演进阶段：从启发式高峰时段规则，到基于逐点机器学习的用户活跃模式预测，再到采用全局固定权重的线性信号组装器，最终演进为通过神经网络生成每用户自适应融合权重的上下文集成学习器。
tldr: 本文提出了一个服务数十亿用户的定时任务执行时间优化系统，通过从启发式规则到上下文集成学习器的四阶段演进，结合学习排序与“最佳时间策略”，实现了跨多样化产品场景的个性化执行时间选择。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a deployed system serving billions of users that optimizes execution times for scheduled jobs through a four-stage evolution culminating in a contextual ensemble learner with per-user adaptive fusion weights, combining learning-to-rank with a "best time policy" across diverse product scenarios.
